name: wwise-wem-wasm
description: Browser encoding and decoding for the WEM kernel: wasm-bindgen shell (crates/wem-wasm) + typed JS wrapper. One-shot and streaming WAV/PCM->WEM (structured profile selection: Wwise generation + PCM geometry) and WEM->interleaved f32 PCM (self-describing: no selection), with the profile bundle compiled in.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:node
